auth.title: Xiaomi Account Login
auth.description:
Please login to your Xiaomi account:

**Step 1:** Open this URL in your browser:
{auth_url}

**Step 2:** Login with your Xiaomi account and authorize.

**Step 3:** After authorization, you will see a success page. Set your Home Assistant callback URL in the input box:
`{callback_url}`

**Step 4:** Click 'Jump' button to complete authorization automatically.

---

*Alternative: If automatic callback doesn't work, you can manually copy the `code` and `state` values from the redirect page and enter them below.*
